label: Dark mode
definition: At least 60% of the section's area is a very dark background (near-black, charcoal, deep navy). Judge the background, not the screenshots inside it.

label: Gradient
definition: A visible colour gradient, mesh, aurora or glow covers at least 25% of the section background. Gradient buttons or gradient headline text alone do NOT count.

label: Bold color
definition: A saturated, clearly non-neutral colour (bright blue, orange, lime, purple, deep green…) fills at least ~30% of the area as background or large panels. Near-black, charcoal or navy dark backgrounds are dark-mode, not bold-color. Coloured buttons, logos, small accents or colourful product screenshots do NOT count.

label: Pastel
definition: Soft, light tinted backgrounds or cards (mint, lavender, peach, baby blue, pale yellow) dominate the look.

label: Warm neutral
definition: The page background is cream, beige, sand or warm off-white rather than pure white or cool gray.

label: Monochrome
definition: The whole palette is black, white and gray (light or dark); any accent colour covers less than ~5% of the area. A prominent colourful product screenshot or photo means NOT monochrome. Can be combined with dark-mode.

label: Bento grid
definition: At least 4 tiles/cards arranged in a grid using at least 2 different tile sizes (spanning cells), like a bento box.

label: Card grid
definition: At least 3 equal-size cards in a regular row or grid.

label: Split layout
definition: The main composition is two columns: a text block on one side and a visual (image, product UI, form, cards) on the other. A headline on the left with only buttons on the right is NOT split.

label: Centered
definition: A single centred column: headline, copy and CTA are centre-aligned.

label: Alternating rows
definition: Two or more rows where text and media switch sides (zig-zag).

label: Tabs
definition: A visible tab bar, segmented control or toggle that switches the displayed content (incl. monthly/yearly toggles).

label: Carousel
definition: A slider: prev/next arrows, dots/pagination, or cards cut off at the edge implying horizontal scrolling.

label: Table
definition: A rows × columns grid of data, prices or check/cross marks.

label: Full-bleed media
definition: A photo, video frame or artwork fills the whole section background behind the text.

label: Product UI
definition: Shows the actual product interface: app/dashboard screenshots or detailed UI mockups.

label: Illustration
definition: A distinct, non-repeating drawn artwork is a focal visual: 2D illustrations, characters, hand-drawn or pixel-art figures, editorial drawings. Simple icons do NOT count, and repeating textures (dot grids, dither fields, line patterns) are pattern-background instead.

label: 3D
definition: Rendered 3D objects, scenes or isometric 3D renders are a prominent visual.

label: Photography
definition: Real-world photos (people, places, physical products) are a prominent visual. Small avatar headshots, logos or UI screenshots do NOT count.

label: Video
definition: A video player, play button or video thumbnail is prominent.

label: Code
definition: A code block, terminal window or API snippet is visible.

label: Form
definition: A visible input control (text field, email field, select, textarea) is a prominent element. Buttons alone do NOT count.

label: Metrics
definition: Two or more large numbers with labels (stats).

label: Logo strip
definition: A row of customer/partner logos inside a section that is not itself a logo cloud.

label: Glassmorphism
definition: Frosted, translucent panels with visible background blur.

label: Pattern background
definition: A repeating texture sits behind the content: grid lines, dot grids, stripes, dither fields, noise or grain. Single focal artworks are illustration instead; plain gradients are gradient.

label: Minimal
definition: At most 2 colours besides neutrals, at least ~50% empty space, no decoration beyond the content itself.

label: Serif type
definition: The main headline is set in a serif typeface.

label: Oversized type
definition: The headline is a dominant visual element: huge display text whose cap height is at least ~8% of the section height, or text spanning the full width.

label: Gradient text
definition: Headline words are filled with a colour gradient.
